name: Russia
description: Follow Russia, a tracked place, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Ukrainian drone attack on the Russian city of Nizhnekamsk kills 12, authorities say
changes.summary: Ukraine has targeted Russian oil facilities with long-range drones almost daily in recent months. The barrage has caused fuel shortages in Russia and unsettled the Russian public. (Image credit: Darko Vojinovic).

changes.title: Ukrainian drone strikes deep inside Russia kill at least 13, authorities say
changes.summary: The death toll is one of the highest among Russian civilians in recent months, as Ukraine seeks to disrupt Russia's oil supply.

changes.title: Drought and the war in Ukraine changed what families in Kenya could afford to eat
changes.summary: Russia's invasion of Ukraine in February 2022 had an almost immediate impact on global energy markets and the movement of food around the world. changes.title: Ukraine Drone Attack on Industrial City in Russia Kills at Least 13
changes.summary: A strike on an industrial center in Tatarstan marked one of the deadliest attacks on Russian territory since the start of the war.

changes.title: Senate votes to sanction Russia after late Sen. Lindsey Graham's push for it
changes.summary: The Senate on Friday overwhelmingly voted for new sanctions on Russia amid its war with Ukraine, which the late Sen. Lindsey Graham had fought for before his death in July.

changes.title: Ukraine denies targeting Bulgaria after drone explodes near gas pipeline
changes.summary: Since the start of Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine, there have been various cases of Ukrainian drones straying into NATO airspace.

changes.title: Syria Agrees to Reorganized Russian Military Presence
changes.summary: After more than a year and a half of negotiations, Syria and Russia have agreed on new parameters of Russia’s military presence in Syria. Syria said it opens the way for a new phase in relations.

changes.title: The U.S. Is Burning Through Weapons in Iran. Russia and China Are Taking Note.
changes.summary: The Iran war has depleted U.S. weapons stockpiles, resulting in a significant erosion of firepower. A more drawn-out Iran conflict benefits Moscow and Beijing, some analysts say.
